Perfect! **Qd5+** is the clearly best move—it wins the knight with check, gaining a whole piece (3 points). After **Kh8, Qxe4** White is up a piece. After **Be6, Qxe6+** White wins the bishop and still attacks the knight.

This is a classic **fork**—the queen checks the king on g8 while simultaneously attacking the undefended knight on e4. After any king move, White captures the knight.

**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent has a piece in the middle of the board (the knight on e4), look for checks that also attack it. **Qd5+** forks the king and knight—the king must move, and the knight is lost. Always scan your checks first; they often deliver material gain on the next move. This is a powerful pattern: check + undefended piece = automatic material win.
